questions.question: How many patients have a normal level of anti-ribonuclear protein and have been admitted to the hospital?
questions.evidence: normal level of anti-ribonuclear protein refers to fld054 = '-', '+-'; And'-' means 'negative'; '+-' refers to '0'; admitted to the hospital refers to fld018 = '+'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld054 = 'negative' OR T2.fld054 = '0' AND T1.fld018 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP = 'negative' OR T2.RNP = '0' AND T1.Admission = '+'

questions.question: Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
questions.evidence: male patients refers to fld014 = 'M'; normal level of white blood cells refers to fld034 > 3.5 and fld034 <9.0; abnormal fibrinogen level refers to fld041 < = 150 or fld041 > = 450; Don't compute repetitive ones.
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld041 <= 150 OR T2.fld041 >= 450 AND T2.fld034 > 3.5 AND T2.fld034 < 9.0 AND T1.fld014 = 'M'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450 AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?
questions.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; 'SJS' refers to diagnosis; (SUBTRACT(year(fld017)), year(fld015)); age of the patients when they initially arrived at the hospital refers to year(fld015)
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld019, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld017) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld015), T2.fld015 FROM tab03 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld008 = 'SJS' AND NOT T2.fld015 IS NULL ORDER BY T2.fld015 ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday),T2.Birthday FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.Birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Please provide the diagnosis of patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range by ascending order of their date of birth.
questions.evidence: ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase beyond the normal range refers to fld021 > 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld021 > 60 ORDER BY T1.fld015 ASC
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC

questions.question: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
questions.evidence: followed up at the outpatient clinic refers to fld018 = '-'; laboratory test in April 1981 refers to fld019 like '1991-10%'; blood bilirubin level within the normal range refers to T-BIL < 2.0;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld018 = '-' AND T2.fld029 < 2.0 AND T2.fld019 LIKE '1991-10-%'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0 AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10-%'

questions.question: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.
questions.evidence: diagnosed with SLE refers to fld008 = 'SLE'; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; normal hemoglobin level refers to 10 < fld036 < 17;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld001, T1.fld014 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld008 = 'SLE' AND T2.fld036 > 10 AND T2.fld036 < 17 ORDER BY T1.fld015 ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For all patients with triglyceride (TG) level beyond the normal range, how many are age more than 50 years?
questions.evidence: triglyceride (fld031) level beyond the normal range refers to fld031 > = 200; more than 50 years of age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)) > 50; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld031 >= 200 AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) > 50
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG >= 200 AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 50
